command: Perform a comprehensive accessibility and interface-parity audit for a requester-owned design system. The exact artifact class is an accessibility and interface parity audit with concrete regression checks; not a competing product clone, new UI, or redesign mock. Scope: synthetic specs only; no scraping, source-code collection, external-server claims, or production policy decision. Inputs: FRAMEWORK_COMPONENT_VOCABULARY_COMPACT_TEXT_INPUT; THEME_AUDIO_PREF_PLACEHOLDER_UI_MAIN_FORMS; FORMS_TABLES_FILE_SPEC_02; FORMS_TOOLTIPS_NOTIFICATIONS_INPUTS_VOICE_AND_VISUAL; SCOPING_THEME_COMPARISON_CHARTS; FRAMEWORK_COMPONENT_INFORMATION_LOCATION_PARAMETERIZED; baseline mobile iOS and Android examples. Outputs: matrix mapping every stated criterion to severity; contrast checks of at least 4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text/UI; focus indicators at least 2 px; visible keyboard focus; no keyboard traps; ARIA/name-role-value correctness; screen-reader and voice-control parity; label/tooltip/error wording; zoom-400 retention; reduced motion; touch targets at least 44x44 logical px; hit-slop 8 px; RTL/LTR; pluralization; caption quality and contrast; audio description cues; dark/high-contrast preservation; orientation and mobile landscape parity; navigation order stability. Document defects for inconsistent labels, duplicated heading order, mismatched tooltip/icon affordance, unusable sidebar navigation, and overflow. Acceptance criteria for internal, viewer, regulator, privacy, contributor, login-gated, and public forms. Verify with Lighthouse/axe_coreAccessibilityUnitTestsPass>=98, AnalyticsSnapshotPlanned=true, pytest tests::audit_visual_and_keyboard_regressions, hashed page baseline, and clear failures-as-feedback. Product names, image paths, localization packs, business units, peer access, and design-tool links remain placeholders. End with ParityChecked>=for_platform_key_component, WCAG_AAReport=false, ProductDescriptionsChanged=false. Keep the response under 1,500 words.
